Layout Rails

Named rails, not max-widths

brxp-rails turns a section into a grid with named lines. Children sit on the content rail and choose a wider one by class.

Symmetric spans

One utility class per rail, and nothing else: no width, no max-width, no negative margins.

Content rail (the default)

brxp-rail-wide

brxp-rail-breakout

brxp-rail-layout

brxp-rail-full: edge to edge, inline padding stripped

brxp-rail-full + brxp-gutter-x: edge to edge with the gutters back

Asymmetric spans

When an element starts on one rail and ends on another, it gets ID-level CSS naming the lines, never a new class.

content-start → full-end, set with ID-level CSS

layout-start → content-end, set with ID-level CSS

Images on rails

Figures pick a rail exactly like any other child. The second one runs edge to edge on the full rail, with its caption's gutters put back by brxp-gutter-x.

Background media

brxp-has-bg-media on the section and brxp-has-bg-media__media on the image: the photo fills the band and is hidden from assistive technology.
